children: Essential Properties Realty Trust released an investor presentation highlighting strong liquidity of ~$1.7B and a 99.6% leased portfolio.
Filed an investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) on Sept 14, 2026 to be used in investor meetings.
Portfolio 99.6% leased with average same-store rent growth ~1.5% over last four quarters.
Pro forma liquidity of ~$1.7B (cash, unused revolver and forward equity adjustments) to support growth.
Low leverage: pro forma Net Debt / Annualized Adjusted EBITDAre 3.5x and 100% asset base unencumbered.
Active investment activity: ~$136M closed in 3Q'26 to date, ~$702M under PSA/LOI; 3Q'26 expected cash yield ~7.6%.
